rival_descriptions.composition: Constant output panel, other lookup depth, inverted initial branch, fixed value1/value2 intermediate, opposite selected intermediate, and an any-panel shortcut.
rival_descriptions.frequency: Choose the less/more frequent present key color without inspecting shape, at each active hop. A present color beats an absent color, positive ties select value1, and both colors absent selects value2.
rival_descriptions.matching: Rotations, reflections, dihedral transforms, one required-cell disagreement, strict template zeros, colorblind occupied-cell matching, mere key-color presence, and either-key dispatch are tested at both hops and separately at each active hop.
rival_descriptions.scope: Finite plausible template-search and lookup-composition alternatives; no universal uniqueness claim.
rival_descriptions.size: Always choose the larger/smaller cropped value area or nonzero foreground count; ties choose value1.

sampling_repairs.color_frequency: The original single-target construction made the true key color consistently rarer than the decoy key color. A source-bound probe on the retained seed 0/17 lessons found the minority-color rule agreed with all 28 labels. The repaired teaching query repeats its true key five times, and a selected value repeats its true key twice, to distinguish template matching from frequency at each hop without adding demonstrations.
